|translation='''Title:''' Block the door!

'''Card text:'''
Use when a battle is declared at an interior location card. Use 1 Force to completely exclude all leaders and all characters with ability > 2 from that battle.

'''Lore:'''
When Vader turned his attention to the Rebels trying to escape, Han shouted to Luke and gave a precise order.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English excludes those characters on both sides.
